name: firetruck-github-action
description: Fail CI when a dependency is tied to a CISA Known Exploited Vulnerability, via the Firetruck API.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
